segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells golf clubs and golf balls for amateur and professional golfers of all skill levels.
segments.evidence: We design, manufacture and sell a full line of high-quality golf equipment, including golf clubs and golf balls.

segments.name: Apparel, Gear and Other
segments.description: Sells premium golf and active lifestyle apparel, gear and accessories under the TravisMathew and OGIO brands.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we had two operating and reportable business segments: Golf Equipment and Apparel, Gear and Other (previously known as the "Active Lifestyle" segment).

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by wholesale customers such as golf course pro shops, off-course and sporting goods retailers, online retailers, distributors and mass merchants, and directly by consumers through websites and retail locations.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our golf equipment products domestically and internationally, directly and through our wholly-owned subsidiaries, to wholesale customers, including golf course pro shops, off-course retailers, sporting goods retailers, online retailers, and third-party distributors, as well as to mass merchants for certain products.

changes.text: In 2025, the company sold the Jack Wolfskin business, which is now reported in discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On May 31, 2025, we completed the sale of 100% of the outstanding equity interests of Callaway Germany Holdco GmbH, which owned the Jack Wolfskin business

changes.text: Effective the fourth quarter of 2025, the company renamed its "Active Lifestyle" segment to "Apparel, Gear and Other" with no change in segment composition.
changes.evidence: effective as of the fourth quarter of 2025, we renamed our "Active Lifestyle" segment to "Apparel, Gear and Other;" this change did not impact the composition of the segment or previously reported financial results.
